paper_title: Maternal plasma cell-free RNA as a predictor of early and late-onset preeclampsia throughout pregnancy
prediction_task: Binary prediction of early-onset (EOPE) and late-onset (LOPE) preeclampsia at 1st (T1) and 2nd (T2) trimester from maternal plasma cfRNA signatures, 8-18 weeks before clinical onset, case-control design

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: External Validation 2 (GSE192902) AUCs dropped sharply (e.g., 0.88 -> 0.68 range; T1 LOPE AUC 0.63), contradicting 'robustness and translational potential' claim; performance gap not transparently reported.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Removed overstatements; reframed Validation 2 as supporting signature relevance with acknowledged modest performance drop due to technical/sampling variability; added full sens/spec/AUC metrics to Results and abstract.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Validation 2 cohort very small (especially T2 subset); balanced case-control down-sampling plus leave-one-out CV on tiny n yields high-variance estimates easily confounded with technical differences.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Explained variability as function of external cohort design/metadata; detailed balanced down-sampling across signature genes + gestational window; evaluated via leave-one-out CV with standard metrics; added methods text.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Severe aspirin-prophylaxis imbalance (71% EOPE / 53% LOPE cases vs 7.6% controls received aspirin) not stratified; cfRNA signature could reflect treatment rather than disease biology and fail in aspirin-naive controls.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Ran PCA, limma-Voom DEG, and classifier-score stratification by aspirin status — no separation or score shift detected; noted T1 sampling preceded aspirin initiation; added clarifying text.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Case-control discovery design instead of case-cohort/nested cohort risks overly optimistic models likely to fail in population-based deployment; limitation not originally acknowledged.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added discussion paragraph conceding case-control optimization limitation; cited ongoing large prospective iPregnostic trial (NCT06716242) for population-level validation.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: External validation results originally buried in figures/tables and omitted from abstract; reduced T1 LOPE AUC (0.68) and Validation 2 AUC (0.63) hidden while discussion touted 'robustness'.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Rewrote Results with sens/spec/AUC inline for external validation; added T1 LOPE (0.68) and Val2 (0.63) AUCs to abstract within 150-word limit per Reviewer #3 round-2 request.
